title: Golden Jubilee Countdown: Fifty Years of Humble Family Service (1976 – 2026)
author: Generalate Council
content:
As our beloved congregation approaches its 50th Anniversary on November 21, 2026, we look back with heartfelt gratitude to God's divine providence.

From the modest beginnings in Mariyapura under the maternal inspiration of Rev. Mother Regina Woroniecka and the guidance of Bishop Mathias Fernandes, the Satyaseva Sisters have grown into a family of 32 communities across Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Assam, Uttar Pradesh, Meghalaya, Germany, and Poland.

Our motto — Satyaseva, Service to Truth — continues to guide our footsteps into the domestic hearths of thousands of families each year.

title: Monsoon Pastoral Mission: Sisters Walk 200+ Kilometers in Village Outreach
author: Sr. Celine SCS, Pastoral Directress
content:
During the recent monsoon months, community sisters across the southern mission stations conducted intensive door-to-door home visitations in 14 remote farming hamlets.

Carrying holy water and the Word of God, the sisters visited over 420 families, holding evening rosary circles under village trees, comforting the sick and elderly with Holy Communion, and reconciling estranged domestic disputes through quiet prayer and attentive listening.

title: New Remedial Education and Nutrition Facility Dedicated in Hunsur
author: Sr. Mary Grace SCS
content:
A newly equipped tuition and nutritional support wing was formally inaugurated at our Hunsur mission community, providing daily evening remedial tutoring, books, and hot meals to more than 90 underprivileged rural students.

Many of these children are first-generation learners whose parents work long hours in agriculture. The center provides a safe, joyful environment where children receive both academic tutoring and character formation.

title: European Mission Reflections: 15 Years of Pastoral Care in Germany & Poland
author: Sr. Nirmala SCS, European Delegate
content:
Satyaseva Sisters serving in our European houses — including Frankfurt, Unkel, and Juist in Germany, as well as Bydgoszcz in Poland — gathered for their annual pastoral evaluation and retreat.

Their work in senior care facilities, parish catechesis, and bedside accompaniment for the terminally ill brings a unique, tender Indian charism of silent presence and deep contemplative prayer to the local dioceses.

title: Three Novices Pronounce First Religious Vows at Mariyapura Motherhouse
author: Sr. Pushpa SCS, Directress of Novices
content:
In an atmosphere of sacred joy and reverent thanksgiving, three young novices — Sr. Anjali, Sr. Theresa, and Sr. Maria Stella — pronounced their first vows of chastity, poverty, and obedience before Mother General and the assembled congregation.

We pray for these dear sisters as they begin their active apostolic ministry in rural catechesis and foster child care.
